dedupeText: mid century crooner album cover mid century modern vinyl record 1950s typography portrait photography living stereo aesthetic crooner subject occupies the right two thirds of the frame creating a strong asymmetrical balance the black header bar anchors the top edge providing a high contrast frame for technical text title typography uses color coding to separate words while maintaining a cohesive stacked block an oval seal graphic provides a secondary focal point in the lower left negative space combine a large scale asymmetrical portrait with a high contrast technical header and a multi colored stacked serif title in the negative space

recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1950s-era vinyl album cover featuring a close-up, slightly angled portrait of a male vocalist against a neutral, textured studio background. The layout is defined by a heavy black header bar with technical branding and a playful, multi-colored title treatment in the upper-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, creating a strong asymmetrical balance.
The black header bar anchors the top edge, providing a high-contrast frame for technical text.
Title typography uses color-coding to separate words while maintaining a cohesive, stacked block.
An oval 'seal' graphic provides a secondary focal point in the lower-left negative space.
coreInvariants: Heavy black horizontal header bar at the top.
Close-up portrait with soft, directional studio lighting.
Stacked, left-aligned title typography with varied colors.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned on the right, cropped at the shoulders and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black header bar at the top and the subject's eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold header, moves down to the colorful title, then follows the subject's gaze toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side, utilized for the title, tracklist, and seal.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted lavender-grey background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black header bar and dark hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant green and blue for the title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the subject's shirt; low saturation in the background; high saturation in the title lettering.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital gradients.
Limit to mid-century primaries: forest green, cerulean blue, and stark black.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses a high-contrast serif with ball terminals and exaggerated descenders.
Header text is a wide, geometric sans-serif with rounded corners.
Tracklist is a small, light-weight sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' in the title features a deep, sweeping hook.
The 'e' characters have a slightly tilted axis.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the artist name paired with a wide, technical sans-serif for the brand/technical info.
graphicDevices: Oval 'Miracle Surface' seal with starburst icon
Thin vertical divider lines in the header

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast serif feel with ball terminals.
Matches the wide, technical sans-serif look of the header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a 1950s male singer in a light blue collared shirt, looking slightly off-camera with a gentle smile. The background is a flat, textured lavender-grey studio wall. Leave the top 15% of the image as a solid black horizontal bar. Leave the left third of the image clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in a stacked, left-aligned serif font in the upper left, using green for the first word and blue for the others. Place wide, white sans-serif text in the center of the black header bar. Add a small black oval seal with a white starburst and fine print in the lower left.

verificationChecks: Is the header bar solid black?
Is the title stacked and color-coded?
Is the portrait lighting soft and directional?
Is the background a muted, desaturated tone?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black bar at the top is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the title text does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the 'vintage print' feel (slight grain/ink absorption).
Confirm the oval seal is present in the lower-left quadrant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large-scale asymmetrical portrait with a high-contrast technical header and a multi-colored, stacked serif title in the negative space.
